titles.en: Model Letters of the Wan Sui Tong Tian Year

attribution.name: 王方庆
attribution.note: The chancellor Wang Fangqing submitted ten scrolls of his ancestors' letters in 697; the court had them copied. He is the compiler of the source material, not the copyist.
attribution.noteZh: 凤阁侍郎王方庆于万岁通天二年进献其先祖法书十卷，内府据以摹写。他是进呈者，非摹手。

attribution.name: 王羲之
attribution.note: His 姨母帖 and 初月帖 open the scroll.
attribution.noteZh: 卷中首列其《姨母帖》《初月帖》。

attribution.name: 未署名
attribution.note: The court copyists who traced and filled the ten letters are not named in the cited sources.
attribution.noteZh: 内府勾填十通书翰的摹手，所引来源均未记名。

compositionDate.note: The year of the submission and of the court copy is written on the scroll itself and repeated by the museum and press accounts.

background: In 697 Wang Fangqing presented ten scrolls of letters by twenty-eight members of his family, including Wang Xizhi and Wang Xianzhi. The court's Hongwen Academy traced and ink-filled them for the imperial collection. Only this scroll survives, carrying ten letters by seven hands. It was damaged in two fires, the Ming-era Zhenshang Studio fire and a Qing fire in the Qianlong palace, and was taken to Changchun in 1922; it is now in the Liaoning Provincial Museum.
backgroundZh: 万岁通天二年（697），王方庆进献其先祖王羲之、王献之等一门二十八人法书十卷，武则天命弘文馆以勾填法摹写留内府。今仅存此一卷，收七人书翰十通。此卷历经明无锡真赏斋火、清乾隆间乾清宫火两次火劫，1922 年由溥仪携往长春，今藏辽宁省博物馆。

review.note: Draft record from a museum collection highlight, a Guangming Online museum feature and a China News Service exhibition report, all read on 2026-11-23. They agree on the 697 submission and the seven surviving hands. The scroll was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的辽宁省博物馆藏品条目、光明网博物馆频道文章与中国新闻网展览报道整理。三处在 697 年进呈与存世七人上一致。未核对原卷。

notes: The ten letters are private correspondence, not composed literary works; the album's value as a modelbook is a later use.
The two fires are recorded without years in the cited pages; no damage assessment is given.
The names of the seven hands follow the Guangming Online list; the scroll itself carries no copyist's signature.
notesZh: 十通书翰本为私人书信，非有意撰写的文章；其作为法帖的价值是后来的用法。
两次火劫，所引页面均未记年份，也未给损伤评估。
七人姓名从光明网所列；卷上无摹手署款。
